description: An unknown map converts to an object type with an optional set its elements don't convert to
notes: The map may lack an element a, which the optional attribute allows, so the conversion isn't provably invalid, and attribute b of the unknown object is an unknown string. Like native/types/convert-unknown-map-to-object-with-unconvertible-optional-list-attribute, with a set of any in place of the list of any.
